description: Aggregate price statistics (low / median / mean / high, farm + observation counts, as-of dates) for a good, nationally or in one province, from Find My Farmer's price ledger. Every bucket covers at least 3 farms and names none; a single farm's own prices, each dated and cited, come from get_farm.

good.description: A goods slug from list_goods, e.g. "grass-fed-beef", "raw-honey".

province.description: Province slug ("alberta"), code ("AB") or name. Omit for national.

name: price_stats
